title: salix myricoides var. angustata
intro: Salix myricoides var. angustata, commonly known as narrow-leaved willow, is a deciduous shrub or small tree in the willow family (Salicaceae). The narrow-leaved willow has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and analgesic properties, which may help to relieve pain and reduce swelling. The bioactive constituents of the narrow-leaved willow include salicin, a compound similar to aspirin, as well as other flavonoids and phenolic acids that may contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of the narrow-leaved willow may be attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antimicrobial properties.
